hero.title: Basmet Dawah
hero.subtitle: New to Islam and not sure where to begin? Basmet Dawah gives you clear, step-by-step learning paths designed by educators — so you always know exactly what to learn next.

features.title: Why Basmet Dawah?
features.subtitle: Everything you need to begin your journey of learning, beautifully organized and always accessible.

structuredPaths.title: Structured Learning Paths
structuredPaths.description: Follow curated paths from basics to deeper understanding, designed by knowledgeable educators.

browseTopics.title: Browse by Topic
browseTopics.description: Explore topics like Prayer, Quran, History, and more — organized in a clear hierarchy.

trackProgress.title: Track Your Progress
trackProgress.description: Mark lessons as complete, take quizzes, and see how far you've come on your learning journey.

bilingual.title: Multilingual Support
bilingual.description: All content available in English, Arabic, and Spanish — with full RTL support for Arabic readers.

topics.title: Explore by Topic
topics.subtitle: Dive into a wide range of Islamic subjects, organized for easy discovery.

paths.title: Don't Know Where to Start?
paths.subtitle: That's exactly why learning paths exist. Whether you just took your Shahada or you've been Muslim for years, these step-by-step guides take the guesswork out of learning. Pick a path, follow along, and grow at your own pace — no confusion, no overwhelm.
paths.reason1: Each path is carefully designed by educators to guide you in the right order — so you always know what to learn next.
paths.reason2: See exactly where you are, what you've completed, and what's coming next. Your progress is saved automatically.
paths.reason3: Whether you want to learn to pray, understand the Quran, or explore Islamic history — there's a path for that.

cta.title: Ready to Start Your Journey?
cta.subtitle: Join thousands of learners exploring Islam at their own pace. Create a free account and begin today.

mentorBanner.title: Need Personal Guidance?
mentorBanner.subtitle: Request a mentor who can answer your questions and support you on your journey.
